name: fairshare-solar
description: FairShare Solar: simulated shared-solar allocation demo (NestJS 11 + Vue 3 + PostgreSQL)

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test:e2e -w api && npm run test:unit -w web -- --run --passWithNoTests
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
